summary: Dane County park page, fees, 2027 schedule, camping rules, FAQ and 5-2025 campground map read; imagery checked. $38 electric / $25 non-electric (2027) + $10 admin fee, $2 senior/military/veteran discount; 37 sites (29 electric 30A, some 50A; no water/sewer at sites); showers/flush/water/dump; 2027 season Apr 30 - Oct 3 (last night); ReserveDane only, 14-night max. DISCOUNT CONFLICT on the county's own site: the 2027 fee table gives a '$2' 'Senior (65+) / Military / Veteran Discount', but the FAQ still says 'There are no discounts for AAA, Good Sam Club, disabled/veterans'. The fee table is the newer document; military set true from it.
HORSES: equestrian trails skirt the park ('take your barefoot horses and enjoy a short jaunt'); no horse sites or horse camping in the campground. Not a horse-rule case.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - Token Creek is a narrow stream in wetland north of the loop, behind trees.
PIN 43.1855,-89.3196 sits at the campground exit on the park road; the loop's centre is ~43.1860,-89.3178 (~150 m east): fine.
